audience: AI engineers and appsec builders on X who ship code fast and distrust scanners that cry wolf
single_takeaway: Strix is open source pentest agents that prove each bug by exploiting it, so what you get is real findings and a fix, not a wall of maybes.
viewer_action: open the repo, star it, quote the video
desired_feeling: the jolt of watching a tool actually break in to prove it's right, then relief that it hands you the fix
references: strix.ai: dark UI, security-console register, one hot alert accent
Burp and terminal pentest tooling: real offensive surface, no marketing gloss
Linear release videos: committed motion, zero-bounce settles
mandatories: strix's own dark security palette, CC BY music attribution, creator tagged, keep copy on the defensive proof-over-guesses value
success_criteria: the creator or the project account quote-posts it, and a muted viewer follows the whole find validate fix argument
